title: Rank-Refined Quantum-Behaved Particle Swarm Optimization for Quantum Molecular Generation
summary: This work proposes Rank-Refined Quantum-Behaved Particle Swarm Optimization (RR-QPSO) for high-dimensional parameter search in Quantum Molecular Generation (QMG). RR-QPSO targets the optimization bottleneck caused by expensive objective evaluations, where each candidate parameter vector requires stochastic circuit sampling, bitstring decoding, and molecular evaluation. The method provides a population-based alternative to Bayesian optimization (BO), combining Sobol-based initialization, a rank-refined mean-best update, and fitness-guided refinement based on validity and uniqueness.…
